### AMD R9700 — Coverage & Limitations

| Metric | Available? |
|--------|-----------|
| GPU Util % | ✅ `amdgpu_gpu_busy_percent` |
| VRAM Used | ✅ `amdgpu_vram_used_bytes` |
| Power Draw | ✅ `amdgpu_power_microwatts` |
| Temperature | ✅ `amdgpu_temp_celsius` |
| Core Clock | ✅ `amdgpu_sclk_mhz` |
| Mem Clock | ✅ `amdgpu_mclk_mhz` |
| VRAM Total | ❌ Always 0 (driver limitation) |
| Per-process metrics | ❌ Not exposed |

**Note:** Most metrics show 0 when the R9700 is idle. The AMD DCGM-equivalent exporter on plex (port 9401) has limited coverage compared to NVIDIA DCGM.

options.content:
### ⚡ MageZero Self-Play

The **AMD R9700** on plex (10.0.0.100) runs **MageZero self-play** — deck-local AlphaZero MTG training via XMage.  
This is bursty: expect **60-70% GPU utilization** during game simulations, then idle between games.

When active, the `amdgpu_gpu_busy_percent` metric will reflect this load. The ollama endpoint (gemma4:12b)
also runs on the same GPU, so high MageZero load will reduce available inference throughput.
